todaysEvents.summary: Hormuz traffic falls to July low
todaysEvents.delta: Reuters/Kpler counted seven commodity vessels crossing on Oct 6, the lowest since Jul 23; crude crossings fell 27% to at least 10.1 million bpd.

todaysEvents.summary: Tanker attacks reach wartime weekly high
todaysEvents.delta: Reuters reported at least 12 oil, LNG and LPG tanker attacks during Sep 28-Oct 5; a separate Oct 10 Riyadh airport attack killed 12 and wounded 309.
On Oct 11 Iran said the US response to its seven conditions was insufficient. No agreement or verified reopening has been reported.

scenarios.label: Base
scenarios.description: Mediation produces agreed sequencing and monitored reopening. Iran says the US reply to its seven conditions was insufficient; a signed deal and durable shipping normalisation remain unverified.

scenarios.label: Stress
scenarios.description: Selective Hormuz passage and export rerouting coexist with record weekly tanker attacks and unresolved reopening terms. Current replacement-supply, freight and cargo-cost observations remain incomplete.

scenarios.label: Tail
scenarios.description: Sequencing disagreements persist or attacks further disrupt Hormuz and alternative export routes. War-risk insurance, route-normalised freight and replacement LNG costs remain unverified.
